description: Lists all Sentry projects the authenticated token has membership access to across all organizations. IMPORTANT: This endpoint returns projects where the token's user is a member. An empty result does NOT mean no projects exist - it means the token lacks project membership. This commonly happens when: - The auth token has organization-level access but not explicit project membership - Projects exist in organizations you can access, but you're not a project member If you receive an empty list but know projects exist, use sentry.retrieve_organization_projects instead, which lists all projects within a specific organization (requires organization_id_or_slug parameter).
